userDescriptionEn: Build browser 3D games with a reusable development flow: input, simulation, rendering, levels and UI. Covers collisions, gravity, joints, particles, effects, performance and lifecycle, with the playable Beacon starter.
userDescriptionRu: Создавайте браузерные 3D-игры на расширяемой основе: ввод, симуляция, визуализация, уровни и интерфейс. Столкновения, гравитация, соединения тел, частицы, эффекты, производительность и жизненный цикл с примером Beacon.
userDescriptionEs: Crea juegos 3D para navegador con una base reutilizable: entrada, simulación, renderizado, niveles e interfaz. Incluye colisiones, gravedad, restricciones, partículas, efectos, rendimiento y ciclo de vida, con el ejemplo Beacon.
agentDescription: Use for building or extending real playable browser 3D games with player input, simulation, rules, objectives, and outcomes. Prioritize a reusable structure separating input, game state, physics, rendering, UI, and level data. Includes the Beacon TypeScript/Three.js/Rapier example and guidance for fixed stepping, controls, lifecycle, assets, Amazi runtime compatibility, and verification. Preserve the user's genre and an existing suitable engine; this skill is not for orbit-only viewers or decorative 3D scenes. Covers advanced collision filtering, sensors, gravity, rigid bodies, constraints, fast-motion detection, particles and effects, with explicit capability choices, lifecycle ownership and a staged playable development flow. Inspect the example’s current structure and import only its standalone application folder contents into Amazi’s allocated application source path.
